Makita DHS680Z 18V LXT brushless cordless circular saw offers high efficiency and powerful performance for professional trade applications. The compact and lightweight design ensures comfortable handling, making it ideal for demanding site work and various timber cutting applications such as framing, roofing, and general carpentry. Features advanced automatic speed control to maintain optimum performance under load, while the built-in dust blower keeps the cutting line clear. The durable power tool is built for tough working conditions, and includes Makita XPT system for enhanced dust and water resistance in harsh weather. The circular saw delivers a maximum cutting depth of 57mm with a 165mm blade. Supplied with blade, hex key, rip fence and dust nozzle.
